weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared crew login; former Conductor's access removed late
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-003; P03 G-035
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering SYS-01, suite, telematics, payroll, keys, tablet, and radio; named crew accounts with MFA; monthly account reconciliation
milestones: 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation; 2026-11-30 named crew accounts live
resources_required: About $1,080 a year (3 licenses); Office Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Backup console and firewall management login accept a password only; telematics portal uses a shared installation password with no MFA
remediation_plan: MSP enables MFA on the backup console and firewall with named MSP accounts; named telematics accounts with MFA and a new password; number matching for suite and SYS-01 push approvals
milestones: 2026-08-06 telematics password changed; 2026-09-15 MFA enabled; 2026-09-30 evidence received

weakness: Backups not immutable; 30-day versions; one admin account can delete them; no company-held copy of operations data; device builds not backed up
remediation_plan: 90-day versioning with immutable retention; weekly export of car inventory and authority history from SYS-01 to the suite; MSP keeps a standard image for the dispatch desktop
milestones: 2026-09-30 weekly export starts; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded; 2026-12-31 dispatch desktop image stored

weakness: No contingency plan testing; backup never restore-tested; paper dispatch never drilled
remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample folder and one mailbox; quarterly restore tests recorded; paper dispatch drill twice a year; annual tabletop using the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-11-30 contingency plan, paper dispatch drill, and tabletop; 2026-12-31 second restore test
resources_required: MSP labor (about 2 hours a quarter); crew time for the drill

weakness: Antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; no behavior-based detection; no false-positive procedure for the radio console software
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring on all 5 computers; alerts to the Office Manager and General Manager by text; radio console software on the EDR allow list with a written false-positive procedure

weakness: Staff not told how and when to report incidents; cyber attacks not reported to TSA within 24 hours; 2025 mailbox compromise unreported
remediation_plan: POL-03 4.2 and 4.4 (approved 2026-08-31); reporting card at the desk and in each cab; TSA report form with cyber fields; ask TSA how to handle the 2025 event
milestones: 2026-09-30 cards posted and staff briefed; 2026-10-15 TSA report form updated and TSA contacted about 2025

weakness: No security literacy training, reminders, or phishing exercises; 2025 compromise not used as a lesson
remediation_plan: Annual online training for all 7 employees; quarterly phishing simulations; monthly reminder; bank-change confirmation rule (POL-02 C.6)

weakness: No audit or sign-in log review
remediation_plan: Monthly 30-minute review of SYS-01 and suite sign-in reports (new devices, foreign locations, crew login use) with a checklist; findings to the General Manager
resources_required: Office Manager time (30 minutes a month)

weakness: No security terms in the MSP contract; no vendor oversight; MSP evidence not received; AI pilot and payroll vendor terms not reviewed
remediation_plan: Operations SaaS vendor SOC 2 review (done 2026-08-19); MSP amendment at renewal (24-hour incident notice, recovery time, MFA, technician list, dispatch desktop approval); AI pilot terms (P10); payroll vendor security report
milestones: 2026-08-19 SOC 2 review; 2026-10-31 AI pilot terms; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment and review
resources_required: Owner and General Manager and Office Manager time; annual MSP review about $500 a year

weakness: Flat network: office and shop computers can reach the dispatch desktop; firewall logs not monitored
remediation_plan: MSP puts the dispatch desktop and radio console on a separate firewall segment that allows only SYS-01, the radio vendor's update service, and the MSP tool; EDR alerts cover monitoring (POAM-005)
resources_required: MSP labor (part of about $1,200 of project time)

weakness: Dispatch desktop on an operating system version past end of vendor support; exclusion made without written approval; no update time limits; firmware testing not recorded
remediation_plan: Replace the dispatch desktop with a supported build and the certified radio console version; written approval for any patch exclusion; 14-day limit for critical updates in the MSP contract
milestones: 2026-11-30 certified console version received; 2026-12-31 desktop replaced; 2026-12-31 contract terms

weakness: SSI-marked TSA documents and the hazmat security plan open to every account, including the MSP administrator
remediation_plan: Restricted folder for the 2 Security Coordinators; remove synced copies from desktops; quarterly access check; SSI rules in POL-04 4.2
